papers.title: How to Fine-Tune a Reasoning Model? A Teacher-Student Cooperation Framework to Synthesize Student-Consistent SFT Data
papers.abstract: A widely adopted strategy for model enhancement is to use synthetic data generated by a stronger model for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, for emerging reasoning models like Qwen3-8B, this approach often fails to improve reasoning capabilities and can even lead to a substantial drop in performance.

papers.title: GlobalSplat: Efficient Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting via Global Scene Tokens
papers.abstract: The efficient spatial allocation of primitives serves as the foundation of 3D Gaussian Splatting, as it directly dictates the synergy between representation compactness, reconstruction speed, and rendering fidelity.

papers.title: HiVLA: A Visual-Grounded-Centric Hierarchical Embodied Manipulation System
papers.abstract: While end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, fine-tuning them on narrow control data often compromises the profound reasoning capabilities inherited from their base Vision-Language Models.

papers.title: Dive into Claude Code: The Design Space of Today's and Future AI Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that can run shell commands, edit files, and call external services on behalf of the user. This study describes its comprehensive architecture by analyzing the publicly available TypeScript source code.

papers.title: Switch-KD: Visual-Switch Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models have shown remarkable capabilities in joint vision-language understanding, but their large scale poses significant challenges for deployment in resource-constrained scenarios. Knowledge Distillation offers a viable way to improve model capabilities.

papers.title: Boosting Visual Instruction Tuning with Self-Supervised Guidance
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models perform well on many vision-language tasks but often struggle with vision-centric problems that require fine-grained visual reasoning. Recent evidence suggests this limitation arises from under-utilization of visual information.

papers.title: OneHOI: Unifying Human-Object Interaction Generation and Editing
papers.abstract: Human-Object Interaction modelling captures how humans act upon and relate to objects. Existing approaches split into two disjoint families: HOI generation and HOI editing.

papers.title: Don't Retrieve, Navigate: Distilling Enterprise Knowledge into Navigable Agent Skills for QA and RAG
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation grounds LLM responses in external evidence but treats the model as a passive consumer of search results, limiting its ability to backtrack or combine scattered evidence.

papers.title: RadAgent: A tool-using AI agent for stepwise interpretation of chest computed tomography
papers.abstract: Vision-language models have markedly advanced AI-driven interpretation and reporting of complex medical imaging. Yet, existing methods largely relegate clinicians to passive observers of final outputs.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning via Value Gradient Flow
papers.abstract: We study behavior-regularized reinforcement learning where regularization toward a reference distribution is essential to prevent value over-optimization caused by erroneous out-of-distribution extrapolation.
